'''Jens Peter Seipenbusch''' (born 6 August 1968<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.kandidatenwatch.de/jens_seipenbusch-602-21517.html |title=Jens Seipenbusch at Kandidatenwatch.de |access-date=2009-07-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090504143700/http://www.kandidatenwatch.de/jens_seipenbusch-602-21517.html |archive-date=2009-05-04 |url-status=dead }} {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090504143700/http://www.kandidatenwatch.de/jens_seipenbusch-602-21517.html |date=2009-05-04 }}</ref>) is a German politician and physicist who was leader of the [[Pirate Party Germany]].

Seipenbusch, a founding member of his party, studied physics at the [[University of Münster]].<ref>[http://www.piratenpartei.de/navigation/partei/bundesvorstand/jens-seipenbusch-(stellvertretender-vorsitzender) ''Jens Seipenbusch (Vorsitzender)''] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090909094146/http://www.piratenpartei.de/navigation/partei/bundesvorstand/jens-seipenbusch-(stellvertretender-vorsitzender) |date=2009-09-09 }}, German Pirate Party's website</ref> He was already party leader from May 2007 to May 2008, and afterwards deputy leader for one year, before he became re-elected leader of the party in July 2009, and once more in May 2010. He did not run again in May 2011.
